scientific_integrity: Proof is finite and exact. A standalone symbolic and exact-enumeration checker supplies corroboration, not an independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Serial, unconditional size-biased recipient sampling with an externally fixed positive boost multiset; expectation of popularity concentration only. No global opinion-dynamics or real-platform guarantee. General second-moment recursion is preexisting; chronological optimization may have unlocated earlier antecedents.
title: Sharp optimal timing of viral popularity boosts under size-biased attention
